title: Seed hand-authored KnowledgeObjects + full M1 integration test suite + close M1 epic
description:
Final M1 issue: prove all done-conditions from ROADMAP.md and close the epic.

Seed fixtures:
  A set of hand-authored KnowledgeObjects (stored as test fixtures or seeded via a helper), covering: academic_pdf (with abstract, authors, year, DOI, arxiv_id), web_article (no year, no abstract, page-less blocks), annotation (annotates the academic_pdf), unknown (edge-case nulls).

Full M1 integration test battery (cargo test --features integration or similar gate):
  1. Seed → rebuild vault → vault contains one note per object.
  2. Delete vault → rebuild → diff empty (§6 test #5, proven in #18 — this is a combined run).
  3. Annotation survives delete-and-regenerate (§9.4 done-condition, proven in #19 — combined run).
  4. Regeneration makes zero LLM calls (assert no API key is needed to run the test).
  5. Re-ingest academic_pdf with same content_hash → ExactMatch, no new object, vault unchanged.
  6. Re-ingest with same DOI but different content_hash → VersionUpdate, existing note updated.
  7. query(content_type=AcademicPdf) returns only the paper.

Closing comment must include:
  - Mutant count per ADR-006 (run cargo-mutants on SqliteLibrary, VaultProjection).
  - Confirmation of all 5 done-conditions from ROADMAP.md M1.

Acceptance criterion: all integration tests pass; all ROADMAP.md M1 done-conditions self-checked and confirmed.
